text:
A Lake Wind Advisory is up today, so the lake is no place for a casual paddle. South winds will run 15 to 25 knots, building waves toward 3 to 5 feet before easing, while Burlington warms from that frosty start to a high near 62 under mostly cloudy skies. Gusts could reach 33 mph on land, too, though there should be plenty of dry hours for errands or a walk. Rain becomes more of a question after 7 tonight, with a 40% chance of showers. The American and ICON models are mostly dry, but the European model is much wetter, so I'd carry the rain jacket rather than bet on staying completely dry.

Thursday brings the better chance of rain, likely before 2, then a few showers or perhaps a thunderstorm, with a high near 64. Keep lake plans short today and be off the broad water before the waves build, then have rain gear ready for Thursday morning.
